title: Changing position is not changing the base
purpose: Compare analytical phase slopes instead of promising unmeasured long-context quality.
contract: R = 4: standard theta = 100, interpolation p/4, and changed theta = 10000.
Only the slower plane is plotted; first-plane frequency stays 1 under a base change.
